conventions.three: metres; +x east, +y up, -z north; right-handed. The world centre (the giant) is the origin.
conventions.ue: centimetres; UE = (x, z, y) * 100, quat = (-qx, -qz, -qy, qw), scale = (sx, sz, sy). Assumes the UE glTF importer maps glTF (x, y, z) to UE (x, z, y); check with kit/DG_AxisMarker.glb first.
conventions.pivot: every kit mesh has its pivot at the centre of its base; scale = dims_m
conventions.poses: each piece lists named poses; the game moves pieces between them with the steering rules in motion{}

corridor.rule: pose = ahead if slot.s > progress + open_at_m; behind if slot.s < progress - close_at_m; else open. progress = furthest route distance reached, capped by the current scene.
